page.notes: Unnumbered page with no running title apart from the head. The catchword is read as "adul-" with a printed hyphen. Several words are doubtful and were copied as printed: "Balci" in the running head, "Abysi" (printed with a long s), "Academiae nomen vulgo", "mar-" in acolytis, and "uindicatus". The line ends in the right column are hard to read in places and are copied as best I could read them.
